_README: Dispatch commission schedule, supplied by the operator 2026-09-02.
Commission is paid on GROSS, but every SOLO and TEAM tier is gated on BOTH a
gross threshold AND a rate-per-mile threshold. That gate matters: it means a
dispatcher cannot earn by hauling cheap freight, which refutes the hypothesis
raised earlier in this engagement that a gross-based commission explained
ZONE's weak revenue per mile. It does not.
The LO/OO schedule is the exception and has NO rate gate at all -- it pays on
gross alone, and it pays 1% even BELOW 8,000 gross. On a lease-to-own or
owner-operator truck the driver bears the fuel, maintenance and truck cost
while the company takes a 12% dispatch fee and the dispatcher takes commission,
both on gross. So on those trucks volume pays everyone except the driver, and
nothing in the schedule rewards rate.

company_stated_breakeven._note: 0.05% applies at break-even and between break-even and the minimum target
